heading: INT. WINTER FORGE - UNDER THE MOUNTAIN - NIGHT

units.text: INT. WINTER FORGE - UNDER THE MOUNTAIN - NIGHT
A cavern lit by one banked fire.
Hammers hang on iron pegs.
Frost grows in the corners, even here.
Anvils stand in a half-circle like old gravestones.
SER ALDRIC VANE, fifties, grey in the beard, in a cloak stiff with ice, stands very straight in the doorway.
He has not removed his gloves.
At the anvil, BRODA STONEHEART, a stout smith with soot on her cheeks, hammers a blade she does not look at.
Beside the fire, a boy of ten, TIBB, feeds scraps of kindling into the embers with the care of a priest.
Against the far wall, in a chair too large for her, LADY MERROWEN sits with her hands in her lap, her eyes closed, her breath making small clouds.
The sword's not ready.
units.name: BRODA

units.text: I did not ask for the sword.
units.name: ALDRIC

units.text: Everyone asks for the sword.
units.name: BRODA

units.text: He takes one step into the room.
The fire flares, then settles.
Tibb looks up at him and then, quickly, at the floor.
How long has she slept?
units.name: ALDRIC

units.text: Since the snow came.
units.name: BRODA

units.text: And the boy?
units.name: ALDRIC

units.text: He sits with her. Feeds the fire. Doesn't speak.
units.name: BRODA

units.text: Aldric crosses to the chair.
He kneels.
He unclasps one glove and lays the bare hand against the Lady's cheek, and she does not stir.
He holds it there far longer than courtesy allows.
Broda sets down her hammer.
The sound rings off the stone.
You came a long way for a woman who won't wake.
units.name: BRODA

units.text: I came to keep a promise.
units.name: ALDRIC

units.text: To her?
units.name: BRODA

units.text: He draws the glove back on, finger by finger.
To the man who gave me the sword.
units.name: ALDRIC

units.text: Tibb reaches into the fire with his bare hand and lifts out a coal.
It does not burn him.
He holds it up in the palm of his hand, glowing, a small red sun.
Broda looks at the coal.
Looks at Aldric.
Slowly, she lifts the blade from the anvil and points it at the door.
Then you had better ask for the sword.
units.name: BRODA
